NVIDIA Streamline SDK v2.14.16 headers (include/*.h), MIT licence (license.txt). Source: https://github.com/NVIDIA-RTX/Streamline release v2.14.16 (2026-10-16), streamline-sdk-v2.14.16.zip, sha256 32041e51db0cab709a271b72a352281b690c2abbd669a827809401a5dd23956b. Unmodified, except that include/sl_nvperf.h (covered by the NVIDIA Nsight Perf SDK licence, not MIT; unused here) is left out.
The runtime loads sl.interposer.dll at run time (no import library is linked). The DLSS binaries (sl.*.dll from the SDK's bin/x64, nvngx_dlss.dll under the NVIDIA RTX SDK licence, bin/x64/nvngx_dlss.license.txt) are not part of this repository.
